name: ACCUMULATE_ATTRIBUTE
text: `execute if score Gold aoe_resN matches Q..`: the resource scores of the game program (#2655)

name: AI_SIGNAL
text: not supported: the bots of the game program run no AI script

name: AI_SIGNAL_MULTIPLAYER
text: not supported: the bots of the game program run no AI script

name: AND
text: the default between two conditions: all conditions of one group in one `execute if ... if ...` line (#2765)

name: BRING_OBJECT_TO_AREA
text: `execute if entity @e[tag=aoe2mc.rN,x=..,dx=..]` in the tick function (units, #2620); a building: `unless score #fN aoe_fallen matches 1..` when its tile is in the area, else never (#3782)

name: BRING_OBJECT_TO_OBJECT
text: `execute at @e[tag=aoe2mc.rA,limit=1] if entity @e[tag=aoe2mc.rB,distance=..T]` in the tick function: within one tile (units, #2771); a building: `positioned` at the corner of the tiles around its tile and the other unit in that box (#3782)

name: BUILDING_IS_TRADING
text: `if score #rN aoe_trade matches 1` (0 when inverted) in the tick function: the scenario mode of the game program sets the score while a trade cart has the market on its route (#2868); a dock: not supported (no trade cogs)

name: CAPTURE_OBJECT
text: `execute if entity @e[tag=aoe2mc.rN,tag=aoe2mc.pN]` in the tick function (units, #2619); a building: `if score #oN aoe_owner matches N`, set by the scenario mode to its owner (#2940)

name: CHANCE
text: `execute store result score ... run random value 1..100` once per second (alone, after the timers or with the ticked conditions: #2574)

name: COMPARE_VARIABLES
text: `execute if score #vA aoe_var <op> #vB aoe_var` in the tick function, once; `unless` for not equal and inverted (#2698)

name: DECISION_TRIGGERED
text: `execute if score #last aoe_decision matches <id × 10 + option>` (`unless` when inverted) in the tick function: the last click on an option of "Create Decision" (#2888)

name: DESTROY_OBJECT
text: `execute unless entity @e[tag=aoe2mc.rN]` in the tick function (units, #2618); a building: `if score #fN aoe_fallen matches 1..`, set by the scenario mode when it falls (#2910)

name: DIFFICULTY_LEVEL
text: `execute if score #level aoe_difficulty matches N` (the game program sets the score, #2704)

name: DIPLOMACY_STATE
text: `execute if score #pN.pM aoe_dipstate matches S` (the stance + 1: the scenario mode of the game program sets the score at the start and after each change, #2757)

name: DISPLAY_TIMER_TRIGGERED
text: `execute if score #doneN aoe_timer matches 1..` in the tick function: the timer sets the score at 0 (#2702)

name: HERO_POWER_CAST
text: not supported: Chronicles only, the game program has no hero powers

name: LOCAL_TECH_RESEARCHED
text: not supported: Chronicles only, the game program has no local technologies

name: OBJECTS_IN_AREA
text: `execute if entity @e[team=pN,x=..,z=..,dx=..,dz=..]`

name: OBJECT_ATTACKED
text: `execute if entity @e[tag=aoe2mc.rN,predicate=aoe2mc:attacked]` in the tick function: the unit took damage from any attacker in the last 10 ticks (HurtTime, or the tag aoe2mc.hit of an AoE2 hit of the game program, #3085), vanilla has no attacker in a selector (units, #2779); a building: not supported yet

name: OBJECT_HAS_ACTION
text: `execute if score #rN aoe_action matches A` (`unless` when inverted) in the tick function: the scenario mode of the game program sets the AoE2 UnitAIAction of the villager state (`scenario.ACTIONS`: build, gather, hunt, move, enter, repair, idle, #2867); another action, a target object or no unit object: not supported yet

name: OBJECT_HAS_TARGET
text: not supported: Minecraft has no readable target of a mob

name: OBJECT_HP
text: `execute store result score ... run data get entity @e[tag=aoe2mc.rN,limit=1] Health` in the tick function, then `if score ... matches` (#2701)

name: OBJECT_NOT_VISIBLE
text: `execute if score #rN.p1 aoe_seen matches 0` in the tick function: the scenario mode of the game program sets the score from the sight of player 1 (#2756)

name: OBJECT_SELECTED
text: not supported: Minecraft has no selection

name: OBJECT_SELECTED_MULTIPLAYER
text: not supported: Minecraft has no selection

name: OBJECT_VISIBLE
text: `execute if score #rN.p1 aoe_seen matches 1` in the tick function: the scenario mode of the game program sets the score from the sight of player 1 (#2756)

name: OBJECT_VISIBLE_MULTIPLAYER
text: `execute if score #rN.pM aoe_seen matches 1` in the tick function: the scenario mode of the game program sets the score from the sight of player M (#2756)

name: OR
text: one `execute if ... run function` line per group in the tick function, with the same fire score `#N aoe_trig`: the trigger runs once (#2765); a timer of a group: a `schedule` sets `#N.t<group> aoe_trig`, the line of the group tests it (#2791); not yet with a chance or in a disabled trigger

name: OWN_FEWER_OBJECTS
text: `execute store result score ... if entity @e[tag=aoe2mc.pN]`, then `if score ... matches ..N` (units only, #2573)

name: OWN_OBJECTS
text: `execute store result score ... if entity @e[tag=aoe2mc.pN]`, then `if score ... matches N..` (units only, #2573)

name: PLAYER_DEFEATED
text: `if score #pN aoe_lost matches 1..` in the tick function: the scenario mode of the game program sets the score when it defeats player N (conquest, regicide, #2710)

name: RESEARCHING_TECH
text: `if score #pN.NAME aoe_techstate matches 2` in the tick function: the scenario mode of the game program sets the AoE2 TechnologyState of the technology (#2769)

name: RESEARCH_TECHNOLOGY
text: `if score #pN.NAME aoe_tech matches 1..` in the tick function: the scenario mode of the game program sets the score of each researched technology (#2656)

name: SCRIPT_CALL
text: not supported: no XS scripts

name: TECHNOLOGY_STATE
text: `if score #pN.NAME aoe_techstate matches Q` in the tick function: the scenario mode of the game program sets the AoE2 TechnologyState of the technology (#2769)

name: TIMER
text: `schedule function ... <s>s` (one function per trigger)

name: TRIGGER_ACTIVE
text: `execute if score #N aoe_on matches 1` (0 when inverted) in the tick function: the state of trigger N (#2699)

name: UNITS_GARRISONED
text: `if score #gREF aoe_gar matches N..` in the tick function: the scenario mode of the game program sets the number of units inside each converted building (#2714); a transport ship: not supported yet

name: VARIABLE_VALUE
text: `execute if score #vN aoe_var matches ..` in the tick function, once (#2611)

name: VICTORY_TIMER
text: `execute if score #pN.T aoe_vic matches ..` in the tick function: the scenario mode of the game program sets the years left on the wonder (T 0), relic (1) or King of the Hill (2) timer of player N and resets the score when the timer stops (#2906); inverted: not supported yet
